pattern_1_chained_vs_loc.conclusion: Chained assignment (df[mask]['col'] = value) raised 1 SettingWithCopyWarning(s) and its effect on the original DataFrame is undefined (may or may not persist depending on whether pandas returned a view or a copy). .loc[mask, 'col'] = value is unambiguous and always correct.

pattern_4_transform_vs_merge.note: transform also avoids the reset_index()/column-rename bookkeeping and cannot silently change row count the way a badly-validated merge could.
